dialogues.jp:
１時限目が終わり、２時限目を過ぎても工藤が
保健室から戻ってくる様子はなかった。
dialogues.en:
Two hours came and went, Kudou still hadn't returned to
class.
dialogues.text:
Two hours came and went, Kudou still hadn't returned to
class.

dialogues.jp:
カバンを取りに来ないところを見ると、早退は
していないようだが……。
dialogues.en:
His bag's still at his table, and he wouldn't leave without
it...
dialogues.text:
His bag's still at his table, and he wouldn't leave without
it...

dialogues.jp: （やっぱり……そんなに具合悪かったのかな）
dialogues.en: "(His condition must be really bad...)"
dialogues.text: "(His condition must be really bad...)"

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく心配になる。もともとそんなに体力
ありそうな奴じゃないしな……。
dialogues.en:
The situation was a worrying. He never looked like he had a
good constitution.
dialogues.text:
The situation was a worrying. He never looked like he had a
good constitution.

dialogues.jp: まぁ、俺の取り越し苦労なのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: Well, I'm probably getting overanxious for nothing.
dialogues.text: Well, I'm probably getting overanxious for nothing.

dialogues.jp: それでもやっぱり、なんだか気になるのだ。
dialogues.en: And I don't know anything right now anyway.
dialogues.text: And I don't know anything right now anyway.

dialogues.jp: （ちょっと様子見に行ってみるか……）
dialogues.en: "(Maybe I should check how he's doing...)"
dialogues.text: "(Maybe I should check how he's doing...)"

dialogues.jp:
そう思い立った俺は、休み時間に入ると保健室
に向かうことにした。
dialogues.en:
With that thought, I stood up and headed for the infirmary
during the rest period.
dialogues.text:
With that thought, I stood up and headed for the infirmary
during the rest period.

dialogues.jp: 「過保護の魂百まで……か？」
dialogues.en: "I'm caring more than I should be, perhaps..."
dialogues.text: "I'm caring more than I should be, perhaps..."

dialogues.jp:
廊下を歩きながら、俺はそう呟いて小さく苦笑
いしていた。
dialogues.en:
I thought to myself as I made my way through the corridors,
smiling bitterly.
dialogues.text:
I thought to myself as I made my way through the corridors,
smiling bitterly.

dialogues.jp:
それは、長年染み付いた習慣みたいなものだろ
うか？
dialogues.en: This has been a habit ingrained into me for a long time now.
dialogues.text: This has been a habit ingrained into me for a long time now.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく、罪な奴だよ｛おまえ／音夢｝は」
dialogues.en: "Damnit, this is all your fault, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Damnit, this is all your fault, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は、ただ単に授業をフケてベッドで寝てる
だけかもしれないっていうのにな。
dialogues.en:
Kudou probably just overslept in the infirmary and missed
the classes because of that.
dialogues.text:
Kudou probably just overslept in the infirmary and missed
the classes because of that.

dialogues.jp:
（……まぁ、それならそれで教室へ連れ戻せば
　いいか）
dialogues.en: "(...In which case, I should just bring him back now.)"
dialogues.text: "(...In which case, I should just bring him back now.)"

dialogues.jp:
まったく、学生の本分たる勉学を怠けようとす
るとは不届きな奴め。俺は自分のことを棚にあ
げてそう思った。
dialogues.en:
Damn you other students, pursuing knowledge mindlessly,
disregarding everything else. At least I have my basic human
morals!
dialogues.text:
Damn you other students, pursuing knowledge mindlessly,
disregarding everything else. At least I have my basic human
morals!

dialogues.jp: 「失礼しまーす……」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me..."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me..."

dialogues.jp:
遠慮がちに声をかけながらドアを開く。……返
事はない。
dialogues.en: I lowered my voice and opened the door. No reply.
dialogues.text: I lowered my voice and opened the door. No reply.

dialogues.jp:
顔だけを中に差し入れて覗いたところ、ゆき先
生の姿は見えなかった。
dialogues.en:
I stuck my head inside and took a quick look around. I
didn't see Yuki-sensei anywhere.
dialogues.text:
I stuck my head inside and took a quick look around. I
didn't see Yuki-sensei anywhere.

dialogues.jp: （ゆき先生……どっか行ってるのかな）
dialogues.en: "(Yuki-sensei... where did she go?)"
dialogues.text: "(Yuki-sensei... where did she go?)"

dialogues.jp: まあいいか、勝手にお邪魔させてもらおう。
dialogues.en:
Well, if she's not here, I don't need to get permission to
go in.
dialogues.text:
Well, if she's not here, I don't need to get permission to
go in.

dialogues.jp: おっかなびっくり床を踏む。
dialogues.en: I furtively tiptoed to the rest beds.
dialogues.text: I furtively tiptoed to the rest beds.

dialogues.jp:
何も不法侵入者ではなし、そんなに緊張する必
要もないのだが――。
dialogues.en:
I'm not some criminal intruder, so there's no need for me to
tense up and behave like this, but I still feel suspsicious
anyway...
dialogues.text:
I'm not some criminal intruder, so there's no need for me to
tense up and behave like this, but I still feel suspsicious
anyway...

dialogues.jp:
部屋に漂う消毒薬の匂いが、ダイレクトに病院
を想像させるからだろうか？　いつ来てもここ
に慣れる事はない。
dialogues.en:
That disinfectant smell lingering about, isn't that direct
from a hospital? I've never smelt it before...
dialogues.text:
That disinfectant smell lingering about, isn't that direct
from a hospital? I've never smelt it before...

dialogues.jp: 「……工藤、いるのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Kudou, are you there?"
dialogues.text: "...Kudou, are you there?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は小声で呼びながらカーテンに囲まれたスペー
スを覗き込んだ。
dialogues.en:
I whispered as I pulled the curtains apart slightly to
create a small space.
dialogues.text:
I whispered as I pulled the curtains apart slightly to
create a small space.

dialogues.jp:
窓際に近いシーツが人のかたちに盛り上がって
いる。そっと首を伸ばすと横たわる工藤の顔が
見えた。
dialogues.en:
I could see an outline of a human lying on a bed through the
curtains. I poked my head inside; it was indeed Kudou.
dialogues.text:
I could see an outline of a human lying on a bed through the
curtains. I poked my head inside; it was indeed Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
すうすうと規則正しい呼吸音がかすかに聞こえ
る。
dialogues.en: His rhythmic breathing was barely audible to my ears.
dialogues.text: His rhythmic breathing was barely audible to my ears.

dialogues.jp: どうやら熟睡しているようだ。
dialogues.en: Looks like he's in a deep sleep.
dialogues.text: Looks like he's in a deep sleep.

dialogues.jp:
その表情は随分おだやかで、なんだか無性にホッ
とした。
dialogues.en: His face exuded complete calmness, easing my worries.
dialogues.text: His face exuded complete calmness, easing my worries.

dialogues.jp: 「いー気なもんだな」
dialogues.en: "I'm coming in..."
dialogues.text: "I'm coming in..."

dialogues.jp:
ぽすりと隣のベッドに腰をおろし、なんとなく
工藤の寝顔を眺める。
dialogues.en:
I took a seat on a chair next to the bed, and somehow or
other, started staring at Kudou's sleeping face.
dialogues.text:
I took a seat on a chair next to the bed, and somehow or
other, started staring at Kudou's sleeping face.

dialogues.jp: 「しっかし……」
dialogues.en: "Really..."
dialogues.text: "Really..."

dialogues.jp:
本当によく眠っている。これなら、どんなこと
をしても目を覚まさないだろうな。
dialogues.en:
He's sleeping really well. I don't think anything I could do
would wake him up.
dialogues.text:
He's sleeping really well. I don't think anything I could do
would wake him up.

dialogues.jp:
白くて｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な頬から顎のライン。長い｛まつげ／睫｝に｛ふちど／縁取｝
られた｛まぶた／瞼｝。それらがミョーに色っぽい……。
dialogues.en:
Delicate-looking chin and cheeks with perfectly clear skin.
Long eyelashes bordering on the eyelids. So many of them...
dialogues.text:
Delicate-looking chin and cheeks with perfectly clear skin.
Long eyelashes bordering on the eyelids. So many of them...

dialogues.jp:
あああ、ヤバいヤバい！　危うく不思議な小道
に迷い込むところだった。
dialogues.en: Ahhh, no no! I almost lost my way down a dangerous path!
dialogues.text: Ahhh, no no! I almost lost my way down a dangerous path!

dialogues.jp: し、しっかりするんだ、俺！
dialogues.en: G, get a hold of yourself, Asakura!
dialogues.text: G, get a hold of yourself, Asakura!

dialogues.jp:
何故か熱くなっている己の両頬をぱんと叩いて
気を取りなおす。
dialogues.en:
I slapped my already-reddening cheeks to snap myself out of
whatever I was in.
dialogues.text:
I slapped my already-reddening cheeks to snap myself out of
whatever I was in.

dialogues.jp:
その気配を感じてか、工藤がかすかに身じろぎ
した。
dialogues.en: Perhaps sensing my uneasiness, Kudou's body started to stir.
dialogues.text: Perhaps sensing my uneasiness, Kudou's body started to stir.

dialogues.jp: （……起こしちまったか？）
dialogues.en: "(....Did he wake up?)"
dialogues.text: "(....Did he wake up?)"

dialogues.jp:
俺はなるべく音をたてないよう、そろそろと腰
をあげた。
dialogues.en: I got up from my seat, making as little noise as possible.
dialogues.text: I got up from my seat, making as little noise as possible.

dialogues.jp: 邪魔してもなんだし、そろそろ戻るか……。
dialogues.en: I shouldn't be a bother, I'd go back to class...
dialogues.text: I shouldn't be a bother, I'd go back to class...

dialogues.jp:
ふにゅふにゅと工藤の口から意味のよくわから
ない寝言が漏れ聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
Kudou started talking incomprehensible gibberish in his
sleep.
dialogues.text:
Kudou started talking incomprehensible gibberish in his
sleep.

dialogues.jp: と、その寝言に混じって、
dialogues.en: In the middle of that nonsense...
dialogues.text: In the middle of that nonsense...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura..."

dialogues.jp:
気のせいか……こいつ今、俺の名前を呼ばなかっ
たか？
dialogues.en: Was that my imagination, or did he just call out my name?
dialogues.text: Was that my imagination, or did he just call out my name?

dialogues.jp: 「工藤、目ぇ覚めてんの？」
dialogues.en: "Kudou, are you awake?"
dialogues.text: "Kudou, are you awake?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は工藤の上に身をかがめた。
dialogues.en: I bended over his body, still lying in the bed.
dialogues.text: I bended over his body, still lying in the bed.

dialogues.jp: ……その、刹那。
dialogues.en: ...Right then.
dialogues.text: ...Right then.

dialogues.jp:
突然工藤が腕を伸ばし、がっしりと俺に抱きつ
いてきた。
dialogues.en: Kudou's hands suddenly shot up, and firmly embraced me.
dialogues.text: Kudou's hands suddenly shot up, and firmly embraced me.

dialogues.jp: 「っな！？　お、おい！　工藤っ！！」
dialogues.en: "Wha!? O, oy! Kudou!!"
dialogues.text: "Wha!? O, oy! Kudou!!"

dialogues.jp:
工藤はうっとりと夢見るような笑顔を浮かべて
いる。
dialogues.en: Kudou, still in dreamland, had a smile floating on his lips.
dialogues.text: Kudou, still in dreamland, had a smile floating on his lips.

dialogues.jp:
……って、こいつは正味夢を見ているのだろう
が。
dialogues.en: ...What the hell kind of dream is he having?
dialogues.text: ...What the hell kind of dream is he having?

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、離っ……」
dialogues.en: "Wait, let go..."
dialogues.text: "Wait, let go..."

dialogues.jp: ね、寝惚けてんのか？　こいつ？
dialogues.en: is this guy half-asleep or what?
dialogues.text: is this guy half-asleep or what?

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、強引に顔を引き寄せられる。何？
何？　何ですか！？
dialogues.en:
And now, he's trying to push my face closer to his. Wait,
what? What? WHAT?!
dialogues.text:
And now, he's trying to push my face closer to his. Wait,
what? What? WHAT?!

dialogues.jp:
パニックに陥った俺が押しのける、いとまもな
く。
dialogues.en: I started panicking too late to change anything.
dialogues.text: I started panicking too late to change anything.

dialogues.jp: 俺達の唇は重なり合っていた。
dialogues.en: Our lips met on top of one another.
dialogues.text: Our lips met on top of one another.

dialogues.jp: 頭の中が真っ白になる。
dialogues.en: My mind went white.
dialogues.text: My mind went white.

dialogues.jp:
ふっと、シトラス系のいい香りがほのかに鼻腔
をくすぐった。
dialogues.en:
The only thing I could comprehend was the sweet citrus smell
in my naval cavity.
dialogues.text:
The only thing I could comprehend was the sweet citrus smell
in my naval cavity.

dialogues.jp: （ああ、シャンプーの匂いか）
dialogues.en: "(Ahh, the smell of shampoo.)"
dialogues.text: "(Ahh, the smell of shampoo.)"

dialogues.jp: それは、女の子の香りだ。
dialogues.en: That's a girl's scent.
dialogues.text: That's a girl's scent.

dialogues.jp:
頭の中が｛しび／痺｝れたようで、何も考えられない。た
だ、やわらかい唇の感触だけが……。
dialogues.en:
My brain went numb, I could think of nothing at all. Just
feel those soft, tender lips on mine...
dialogues.text:
My brain went numb, I could think of nothing at all. Just
feel those soft, tender lips on mine...

dialogues.jp: ああ、気持ちいいな。キスって
dialogues.en: Ahh, so this is how a kiss feels like. How amazing.
dialogues.text: Ahh, so this is how a kiss feels like. How amazing.

dialogues.jp: ……チョットマテ！！
dialogues.en: ...NOW HOLD ON HERE!!
dialogues.text: ...NOW HOLD ON HERE!!

dialogues.jp: 「っかああぁぁああ！！！」
dialogues.en: "GAHHHHHHHHH!!!"
dialogues.text: "GAHHHHHHHHH!!!"

dialogues.jp:
我に返った俺は、渾身の力をこめて工藤をひっ
ぺがした。
dialogues.en:
As I returned to my senses, I used alll the strength I had
to escape Kudou's death grip.
dialogues.text:
As I returned to my senses, I used alll the strength I had
to escape Kudou's death grip.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「うぅん…………あれ……朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Uhhnn.... huh.... Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Uhhnn.... huh.... Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: 目をこすりつつ眠たげな声を出す工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou started talking in a sleepy voice, rubbing his eyes.
dialogues.text: Kudou started talking in a sleepy voice, rubbing his eyes.

dialogues.jp: ぜえぜえはぁはぁ……。
dialogues.en: Pant pant, pant pant...
dialogues.text: Pant pant, pant pant...

dialogues.jp: 俺は必死になって呼吸を整えていた。
dialogues.en: I was desperately gasping for air.
dialogues.text: I was desperately gasping for air.

dialogues.jp:
耳たぶまで真赤になっているのが自分でもよく
分かる。
dialogues.en:
I could feel my ears glowing bright red from that whole
experience.
dialogues.text:
I could feel my ears glowing bright red from that whole
experience.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「何やってんだよ、お前」
dialogues.en: "What's up with you?"
dialogues.text: "What's up with you?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤はそんな俺をきょとんとした目で眺めてい
る。
dialogues.en: He looked at me with curious eyes.
dialogues.text: He looked at me with curious eyes.

dialogues.jp: 落ち着け落ち着け落ち着け。
dialogues.en: Calm down calm down calm down.
dialogues.text: Calm down calm down calm down.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたのかよ」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on?"

dialogues.jp:
なかなか言葉に出せない俺を見ながら、｛けげん／怪訝｝な
声を出す工藤。
dialogues.en:
Not getting any understandable response from me, his voice
grew more dubious.
dialogues.text:
Not getting any understandable response from me, his voice
grew more dubious.

dialogues.jp: 「……何も……憶えてないのか？」
dialogues.en: "... You don't.... remember anything?"
dialogues.text: "... You don't.... remember anything?"

dialogues.jp:
あんな大それたことをしでかしながら……そん
なのってないだろ、おい。
dialogues.en: He can't have not noticed such a thing, could he?
dialogues.text: He can't have not noticed such a thing, could he?

dialogues.jp: しかし、工藤は罪のない顔で首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Yet, his face showed complete innocence.
dialogues.text: Yet, his face showed complete innocence.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なにが？」
dialogues.en: "Remember what?"
dialogues.text: "Remember what?"

dialogues.jp: はあぁぁぁぁ……。
dialogues.en: Haaaaaah...
dialogues.text: Haaaaaah...

dialogues.jp: なんだかわからんが溜息が長々と漏れる。
dialogues.en:
I released a long, long sigh. He really doesn't know
anything...
dialogues.text:
I released a long, long sigh. He really doesn't know
anything...

dialogues.jp:
「いや……憶えてないんなら……いい。俺もな
　かったことにする」
dialogues.en:
"No... it's probably better if you don't know. I'd try to
forget it too."
dialogues.text:
"No... it's probably better if you don't know. I'd try to
forget it too."

dialogues.jp:
意味もなく、自分の鼻をつまんで俺は言葉を返
した。
dialogues.en: I unconciously started rubbing my nose, as I replied.
dialogues.text: I unconciously started rubbing my nose, as I replied.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だから何がだよ」
dialogues.en: "That doesn't answer anything."
dialogues.text: "That doesn't answer anything."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……気にするな。それより、調子はどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "...Don't worry about it. Anyway, how are you feeling?"
dialogues.text: "...Don't worry about it. Anyway, how are you feeling?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤の追及をかわすように話をはぐらかし
た。
dialogues.en:
I changed the topic before Kudou could ferret anything out
of me.
dialogues.text:
I changed the topic before Kudou could ferret anything out
of me.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、薬もらって飲んだらずいぶん楽になっ
　たよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I felt a lot better once I took some medicine."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I felt a lot better once I took some medicine."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……そいつはとんちがきいてるや」
dialogues.en: "...That's not bad... okay... or something."
dialogues.text: "...That's not bad... okay... or something."

dialogues.jp: 俺の返答は、我ながら意味不明だった。
dialogues.en: Even I knew I was just rambling now.
dialogues.text: Even I knew I was just rambling now.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それに……いい夢も見られたしな」
dialogues.en: "And... I had a sweet dream."
dialogues.text: "And... I had a sweet dream."

dialogues.jp: かすかに頬を染めてつぶやく工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou smiled, his cheeks radiating with colour.
dialogues.text: Kudou smiled, his cheeks radiating with colour.

dialogues.jp: 色々と墓穴だとは思いながら尋ねてみる。
dialogues.en: I mindlessly asked the first thing that came to mind.
dialogues.text: I mindlessly asked the first thing that came to mind.

dialogues.jp:
「ははは、それって、好きな子とキスする夢と
　かだったりしてな」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha, let me guess, a dream where you kissed the one you
liked?"
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha, let me guess, a dream where you kissed the one you
liked?"

dialogues.jp:
途端に工藤は、ぱっと顔を赤らめてうろたえる
素振りを見せた。
dialogues.en: His face suddenly turned red, as I hit the target.
dialogues.text: His face suddenly turned red, as I hit the target.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「っ！！　な、なんで分かるんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Uh!! H, how did you know!?"
dialogues.text: "Uh!! H, how did you know!?"

dialogues.jp: ……やはりな。
dialogues.en: ...It really is that.
dialogues.text: ...It really is that.

dialogues.jp:
「……セブンセンシズのなせる業、とでも言っ
　ておこうか」
dialogues.en: "...My seventh sense told me so."
dialogues.text: "...My seventh sense told me so."

dialogues.jp: 遠い、遠い目をして答える俺。
dialogues.en: I answered, my eyes gazing far into the distance.
dialogues.text: I answered, my eyes gazing far into the distance.

dialogues.jp: （それにしても……夢……アイタタタ……）
dialogues.en: "(And that was really... his dream... gahgahgah...)"
dialogues.text: "(And that was really... his dream... gahgahgah...)"

dialogues.jp: 俺の純潔を奪っておいてそれか……。
dialogues.en: And I've lost my chastity to... that...
dialogues.text: And I've lost my chastity to... that...

dialogues.jp: ああ、この世には神も仏もいないのか。
dialogues.en: Ahh, this world really has no God.
dialogues.text: Ahh, this world really has no God.

dialogues.jp: 「……治ったんなら、さっさと教室来いよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Since you've recovered now, hurry up and go back to
class already."
dialogues.text:
"...Since you've recovered now, hurry up and go back to
class already."

dialogues.jp: 俺はふらふらと工藤に背を向けた。
dialogues.en:
I unsteadily got up and started heading out of the
infirmary.
dialogues.text:
I unsteadily got up and started heading out of the
infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
いっしょに歩きながら教室へなどとてもじゃな
いが戻れたものではない。
dialogues.en: I definitely didn't want to walk back together right now.
dialogues.text: I definitely didn't want to walk back together right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura..."

dialogues.jp: 歩き出しかける背中に呼びかける工藤の声。
dialogues.en: As I started to leave, Kudou called out to me.
dialogues.text: As I started to leave, Kudou called out to me.

dialogues.jp:
喉の奥で答えて、俺は振り向かなかった。きっ
と今の俺は、形容できかねる表情をしているで
あろうと思ったので。
dialogues.en:
I answered with inside my throat, not able to turn around to
face him. I didn't want him to see my face now...
dialogues.text:
I answered with inside my throat, not able to turn around to
face him. I didn't want him to see my face now...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「心配してくれて有難うな」
dialogues.en: "Thanks for your concern."
dialogues.text: "Thanks for your concern."

dialogues.jp:
それはごくごく自然な、多分心から出たであろ
う言葉だった。
dialogues.en: Simple words of gratitude straight from the heart.
dialogues.text: Simple words of gratitude straight from the heart.

dialogues.en: "...You're welcome."
dialogues.text: "...You're welcome."

dialogues.jp:
俺はそんな工藤に向かって、ひらひらと手を振っ
て返した。
dialogues.en: I waved as I exited the infirmary.
dialogues.text: I waved as I exited the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
そしてそんな、無邪気な工藤に対して、俺は被
害者であるはずなのに、訳のわからない罪悪感
を覚えていた。
dialogues.en:
Compared to that completely unwitting Kudou, I've become a
damaged man, with feelings of guilt abound.
dialogues.text:
Compared to that completely unwitting Kudou, I've become a
damaged man, with feelings of guilt abound.

dialogues.jp: ◆１ｓｔ　Ｋｉｓｓ◆
dialogues.en: ◆First Kiss◆
dialogues.text: ◆First Kiss◆

dialogues.jp:
保健室に連れて行った工藤はやはり体調が悪かっ
たらしくなかなか帰ってこなかった。
dialogues.en:
Kudou, who had went to the infirmary earlier, never
returned. His condition must really be bad.
dialogues.text:
Kudou, who had went to the infirmary earlier, never
returned. His condition must really be bad.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず保健室に様子を見に行った俺だが、
何と寝ぼけた工藤にファーストキスを奪われて
しまう。
dialogues.en:
I went to visit him in the infirmary, and somehow, the
sleeping Kudou stole my first kiss.
dialogues.text:
I went to visit him in the infirmary, and somehow, the
sleeping Kudou stole my first kiss.

dialogues.jp:
しかも、目覚めた工藤はまったくその所業を覚
えていなかった。
dialogues.en:
Yet, when he woke up, he was completely clueless on what he
did.
dialogues.text:
Yet, when he woke up, he was completely clueless on what he
did.

dialogues.jp:
素直に俺に礼を言う工藤に、俺は脱力と憤り、
そして何故か、ほんの少しの罪悪感を覚えたの
だった。
dialogues.en:
Even after he thanked me for my concern, I still harboured
feelings of guilt, exhaustion and resentment.
dialogues.text:
Even after he thanked me for my concern, I still harboured
feelings of guilt, exhaustion and resentment.
